title: ERP Finance Specialist
minimumQualification: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related field. Technical
jobDescription: Job Description: We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical ERP Finance Specialist with 3 to 4 years of experience to bridge the gap between our finance operations and our technology infrastructure. In this role, you will be the go-to person for maintaining, optimizing, and supporting our ERP finance modules (e.g., SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or Workday). You will work closely with the accounting and finance teams to streamline financial workflows, ensure data integrity, troubleshoot system issues, and lead minor enhancement projects. Key Responsibilities: System Maintenance & Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day ERP finance module issues (General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, and Cost Accounting). Process Optimization: Analyze existing financial workflows and implement system configurations or automation to improve efficiency and accuracy. Month-End & Year-End Close Support: Assist the finance team during critical closing periods by ensuring system readiness, reconciling sub-ledgers, and resolving posting errors. Reporting & Analytics: Design, build, and maintain financial reports, dashboards, and queries within the ERP or integrated BI tools. Testing & Deployment: Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for system upgrades, patches, and new feature rollouts. Training & Documentation: Create user guides and conduct training sessions for finance team members to ensure best practices in system utilization. Required Qualifications & Skills Experience: 3–4 years of hands-on experience supporting or implementing ERP financial modules. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related field. Technical Proficiency: Strong configuration skills in at least one major ERP system (e.g., SAP FI/CO, NetSuite, Dynamics 365 Finance, Oracle ERP Cloud). Solid understanding of SQL, financial reporting tools, or data visualization software (Power BI/Tableau) is a major plus. Domain Knowledge: Solid grasp of core accounting principles (GAAP/IFRS), financial reporting, and internal controls. Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving abilities, excellent communication skills to translate technical concepts to non-technical users, and a collaborative mindset. title: Specialist – TMF & Utility Billing
requiredSkills: TM Forum (TMF) Open APIs and frameworks (SID
jobDescription: Position Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated TMF Specialist with Utility Billing expertise to join our enterprise solutions team. The ideal candidate will possess 5+ years of experience in the Telecom industry, with a deep understanding of TM Forum (TMF) Open APIs and frameworks (SID, eTOM). In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional telecom OSS/BSS frameworks and modern Utility Billing systems (Water and Electricity). You will be responsible for designing, integrating, and optimizing billing solutions that support multi-play services, ensuring seamless revenue management and data synchronization. Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture & Integration: Design and implement billing and revenue management solutions integrating Telecom OSS/BSS with Water and Electricity utility billing systems. TMF Standards Application: Apply TM Forum Open APIs (such as TMF620 Product Catalog, TMF622 Product Ordering, TMF678 Customer Bill Management, and TMF632 Organization Management) to standardize data exchange between utility frameworks and telecom platforms. Billing Configuration: Configure and manage complex billing cycles, tariff structures, rating engines, and invoicing for water, electricity, and telecom bundled services. Data Modeling: Utilize the TM Forum Information Framework (SID) to map utility specific attributes (e.g., meter readings, consumption metrics, grid topologies) into standard telecom data models. Process Optimization: Align business processes with the TM Forum Business Process Framework (eTOM), specifically focusing on Order-to-Activate (O2A) and Lead-to-Cash (L2C) cycles for utilities. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Telecom Network Engineers, Utility Grid Operations, Product Managers, and IT Infrastructure teams, to deliver end-to-end solutions. Requirement Gathering & Analysis: Actively engage with clients to capture their exact business requirements, translating complex utility and telecom needs into actionable technical specifications. Technical Advisory: Provide clear technical clarity and direction to stakeholders, breaking down complex TMF architectures and utility billing processes into easily understandable concepts. Consultative Solutioning: Analyze client challenges to propose optimal, scalable solutions that align with both business goals and TM Forum best practices. Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, managing communications effectively to build trust and ensure alignment across all phases of the project delivery. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in the Telecom sector working on BSS/OSS transformations, specifically within billing and revenue management. Domain Expertise: Proven experience handling Utility Billing systems for Water and Electricity (e.g., experience with SAP IS-U, Oracle Utilities, or similar MDM/Billing platforms is a major plus). jobDescription: Job Description: We are seeking a visionary and highly technical Technical Architect with 5 or more years of experience to define, design, and oversee the execution of our software ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical implementation, ensuring our platforms are scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable. You will be responsible for defining architectural blueprints, selecting technology stacks, and guiding engineering teams through complex technical challenges. This role requires a balance of high-level strategic thinking, hands-on technical leadership, and exceptional stakeholder management. Key Responsibilities Architectural Blueprinting: Design end-to-end software architectures, microservices frameworks, and system integrations that align with long-term business goals. Technology Evaluation: Lead the evaluation, prototyping, and selection of software tools, frameworks, cloud services, and database systems. Technical Governance: Establish, promote, and enforce coding standards, architectural principles, data security protocols, and CI/CD best practices across engineering teams. Scalability & Performance: Identify potential system bottlenecks, architect for high availability and disaster recovery, and optimize infrastructure cost-efficiency. Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Act as a technical authority, conducting design reviews, resolving complex technical roadblocks, and mentoring senior and staff engineers. Stakeholder Collaboration: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable business insights for executives, product managers, and external clients. Required Qualifications & Skills Experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a dedicated architecture, tech lead, or systems design role. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Software Design Expertise: Deep understanding of architectural patterns (Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Serverless, Domain-Driven Design). Cloud Architecture: Proven experience architecting solutions on major cloud platforms ( AWS, Azure, or GCP ). Cloud Architect Certification is highly desirable. Full-Stack Proficiency: Strong background in back-end technologies (Java, Go, Python, or .NET) and familiarity with modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular). Data Systems: Deep knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and non-relational (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis) databases, caching strategies, and data streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ). jobDescription: Job Description We are looking for a seasoned Senior Data Engineer with over 5 years of experience to design, build, and optimize our core data infrastructure. In this role, you will architect robust data pipelines, scale our data warehouse, and ensure that our data systems are highly available, reliable, and secure. As a senior member of the team, you will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Managers to turn raw data into actionable insights, while mentoring junior engineers and championing engineering best practices. Key Responsibilities Architecture & Pipeline Development: Design, construct, install, and maintain highly scalable data management systems and end-to-end ELT/ETL pipelines. Data Warehousing & Modeling: Optimize data environments (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and design efficient data models (Star/Snowflake schemas) for complex datasets. Performance Tuning: Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipeline performance, ensuring low latency and cost-effective cloud resource utilization. Data Governance & Security: Implement data quality checks, data masking, and access controls to ensure strict compliance with security and privacy standards. DevOps & Automation: Integrate CI/CD practices into data engineering workflows and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) where applicable. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in data engineering or back-end software engineering with a heavy focus on data infrastructure. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Programming Languages: Expert-level proficiency in Python , SQL , and familiarity with Scala or Java. Big Data & Cloud Technologies: * Proven experience with cloud platforms ( AWS, GCP, or Azure ). jobDescription: Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and collaborative Lead Full-Stack Developer to drive the development of our web applications. In this role, you will be both a hands-on developer and a technical leader, managing a team of engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable, and user-centric software. You will own the technical roadmap for your product area, making critical architecture decisions across both the front-end and back-end ecosystems, while fostering a culture of engineering excellence through mentorship and code reviews. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership: Lead an agile team of developers, guiding sprint planning, task estimation, code reviews, and technical design sessions. Full-Stack Development: Architect, develop, and maintain robust front-end user interfaces and scalable back-end services (approx. 60% hands-on coding, 40% architecture/leadership). Architecture & Integration: Design secure, efficient RESTful APIs or GraphQL endpoints, and optimize data schemas for relational and non-relational databases. DevOps & Delivery: Oversee automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure seamless software delivery. Performance & Security: Identify system bottlenecks, optimize application performance for maximum speed and scalability, and implement web security best practices (OWASP Top 10). Mentorship: Coach and mentor junior and mid-level developers, supporting their professional growth and establishing best practices across the team. Required Qualifications & Skills Experience: 7+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or mentoring capacity. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). Front-End Expertise: Deep proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern front-end frameworks—specifically React.js , Angular , or Vue.js —along with HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design. Back-End Expertise: Strong experience with back-end technologies such as Node.js , Python (Django/FastAPI) , Java (Spring Boot) , or .NET . Database & Caching: Proven experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis). Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with cloud infrastructure ( AWS, GCP, or Azure ) and containerization technologies ( Docker , Kubernetes).
